title: SDR signal record
description: One buying-intent signal detected on LinkedIn. One JSON object per line in signals.jsonl.

type.description: keyword_post = a post/comment matched a pain-point or topic keyword (lowest signal, mostly vendor/ad noise in testing). job_change = someone at a relevant title/company signaled a new role. exec_search = a named executive/decision-maker found via title+sector people search (highest signal, the primary pass as of 2026-07-28). company_match = a target account found via company search.

posted_at.description: Best-effort date the underlying post/announcement went live; null if only a relative time ("2d") was legible and couldn't be resolved.

source_url.description: The LinkedIn post or profile URL that surfaced the signal; the dedupe key.

keyword_matched.description: The keyword/phrase from references/keywords.md that matched, for keyword_post signals.

query_used.description: The exact search query that surfaced this signal (e.g. '"Gerente General" cooperativa'). Kept so keywords.md can be tuned from what actually worked.

snippet.description: The text that triggered the flag (post excerpt or announcement line). Never fabricated; verbatim or empty.

connection_degree.description: LinkedIn connection degree to Pedro, for exec_search signals. A warm-intro signal: 2nd with named mutuals is worth prioritizing over a cold 3rd+.

mutual_connections.description: Named mutual connections shown by LinkedIn (as displayed, may be a partial list plus a count in the raw UI). Empty array if none shown or not applicable.

org_fit.description: Best-effort fit flag against references/keywords.md's exclusion patterns (e.g. employer-affiliated employee coops that aren't lenders). null if not assessed.

company_size.description: LinkedIn's employee-count range (e.g. '1K-5K employees'), for company_match signals.

followers.description: LinkedIn follower count at time of detection, for company_match signals.

score.description: Filled by the future /ps:sdr intent-score subcommand; null until then.

icp_match.description: Filled by the future /ps:sdr icp-match subcommand; null until then.

status.description: new = untouched. reviewed = Pedro looked at it. actioned = became outreach. dismissed = not relevant.
